verdict.rationale: Synthesia's docs cover most of the agent loop. The asynchronous Video API lets an agent submit a job, then poll or receive a webhook on completion. The response returns a time-limited download link for the .mp4. A Billing API exposes the credit balance, and a docs llms.txt supports agent-readable onboarding. Cost reporting stops at workspace-level balance and billing period, and the Video API is described as scripted avatar videos rather than free-form prompts. Missing for 10: per-job cost or credit-consumption reporting, explicit prompt-to-video via API, and hands-on corroboration that an agent completes the loop from docs alone.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: Asynchronous — you submit a job and poll or get a webhook when it's ready.
it is possible to configure a webhook to which Synthesia sends a notification when a video completes successfully.
the response includes then a time-limited download link in the `download` attribute, use this link to download the video as an `.mp4`
Billing API — retrieve your workspace's current billing period and credit balance programmatically.
